Locally served xterm assets; MIT licenses are included next to each library.
Source: published npm packages via https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/
@xterm/xterm 5.5.0: lib/xterm.js, css/xterm.css, LICENSE
@xterm/addon-fit 0.10.0: lib/addon-fit.js, LICENSE
@xterm/addon-web-links 0.11.0: lib/addon-web-links.js, LICENSE
These are pinned assets, not fetched by end-user browsers. Review and update
this directory when upgrading the frontend terminal dependencies.
